summary.text: Mark Willis is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives who represents District 16, having assumed office in 2008, and is seeking re-election in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as long-term care administrator, and notes that the Republican primary for his seat was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Willis earned a B.A. from Erskine College in 1986 and is a long-term care administrator, according to Ballotpedia.
He is assigned to the Ways and Means Committee in the 2025-2026 session, and he chaired the Interstate Cooperation Committee in the 2023-2024 session.
